scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: REV2. PASS covers only the 9 actual complete 100-card configurations in the rev2 pool (baseline, preferred six, rev1 five as history, two seven-swap rev2 alternatives, a 34-land six alternative and three rev1 larger alternatives) plus named single-card contenders, judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases and quantity-counted whole-deck comparison. Tests run locally and in the focused GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/m7-admiral-brass-unsinkable.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body, not here. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking. A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
